description: Defines an abstract class 'Compare' with multiple nested classes implementing various comparison operations (e.g., equals, greater, less, is-null). It provides methods for obtaining comparison instances and performing comparisons with type conversions, used within the 'minilang' framework of Apache OFBiz.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: Abstract class implementing comparison logic with various static nested classes for specific comparison operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a Compare instance for the specified operator string.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Abstract method to perform comparison between two objects with type, locale, timezone, and format considerations.
